C1414.title: Polymarket UMA Oracle Disputed Resolution Incident
C1414.summary: In March 2025, a Polymarket market on whether the United States and Ukraine would agree to a minerals deal before April entered UMA's dispute-resolution process and settled as Yes before the deadline. Reporting said more than $7 million had been wagered and that a participant holding a large amount of UMA governance tokens had significant influence over the vote. Polymarket called the situation unprecedented and said it would work with UMA to improve dispute handling.
